models.title: Tall Brig Curlew
models.description: 42 m two-masted square-rigged brig assembled with topmasts, jibboom, standing shrouds and ratlines, six bracing yards, six roached square sails, gaff spanker, fore staysail, and outer jib.
models.unreal_role: Articulated 2-Mast Merchant Brig ( Hull + 17 Animated Rig & Sail Parts )

models.title: Breastwork Turret Ironclad
models.description: 125 m breastwork turret ironclad with tumblehome armoured casemate, underwater ram bow, twin central funnels, and fore-and-aft heavy gun turrets. Web mesh generated from project concept art; the in-game hero hull is a separately credited model (see CREDITS.md).
models.unreal_role: Capital Escort & Coastal Bombardment Ironclad ( 125 m, 8,000 t )

models.title: Brass-Plated Cargo Dirigible
models.description: 110 m bluff-hulled steampunk cargo airship with ribbed canvas-and-brass envelope, underslung cargo gondola, external catwalks, cruciform tailplanes, and four outrigger propellers.
models.unreal_role: High-Altitude Heavy Freight Dirigible ( 4 Outrigger Screws, 310 m Cruise )

models.title: Crown Patrol Airship Aurora Watch
models.description: 70 m Crown aerial patrol dirigible assembled from PatrolAirshipV4 with twin forward nacelle tractor screws and an aft cruciform tail pusher propeller in laminated mahogany and polished brass.
models.unreal_role: Harbour Overwatch & Reconnaissance Dirigible ( 3 Spinning Screws, 240 m Cruise )

models.title: Side-Wheel Steamer Duchess of Kestrel
models.description: 45 m side-wheel packet steamer assembled with recessed sponson wheel-wells and port/starboard multi-spoke iron and red-timber paddle wheels.
models.unreal_role: Packet & Passenger Side-Wheel Steamer ( Dual Sponson Wheels + Churn FX )

models.title: Salvage Tender Dredger's Hope
models.description: 30 m iron salvage workboat equipped with an aft steam-winch turntable, twin-leg A-frame derrick boom slewed 22 degrees outboard, and a suspended brass-portholed diving bell.
models.unreal_role: Wreck-Diving Support Vessel ( Slewing A-Frame Derrick + Pendulum Diving Bell )

models.title: Crewed Harbour Rowing Gig
models.description: 8 m clinker-built wooden harbour gig crewed by three 1870s oilskin oarsmen seated on the thwarts, a stern-sheets coxswain, and six spoon-bladed ash oars mounted in brass gunwale crutches.
models.unreal_role: Inner-Harbour Ship-to-Shore Gig ( 6 Synchronised Oars + 4 Seated Crew )

models.title: Tramp Collier SS Calloway
models.description: 50 m iron-hulled coastal tramp collier with raised forecastle, central bridge deckhouse, tall black funnel, and fore-and-aft cargo derricks.
models.unreal_role: Coastal Coal & Ore Freighter ( 50 m Bulk Merchant Traffic )

models.title: Pilot Cutter Pathfinder
models.description: 18 m gaff-rigged pilot cutter with tan weather-cloth mainsail, staysail, jibboom headsail, and bold hull pilot markings built for rough bar crossings.
models.unreal_role: Fast Channel Pilot & Escort Cutter ( Bar Entry & Reef Guidance )

models.title: Steam Harbour Tug Hodman
models.description: 22 m heavy steel harbour steam tug fitted with a braided rope bow pudding fender, forward timber wheelhouse, tall coal stack, and low aft towing deck.
models.unreal_role: High-Thrust Berthing & Towage Steam Tug ( 22 m Harbour Workhorse )

models.title: Brass Steam Pinnace
models.description: 15 m Victorian naval steam launch featuring a plumb stem, exposed vertical brass boiler and raked funnel forward, and a stanchion-supported passenger canopy aft.
models.unreal_role: Admiralty Officer & Quay Dispatch Launch ( 15 m Canopy Steam Boat )

models.title: The Anchor & Brass Tavern
models.description: 11 m half-timbered harbourfront tavern with stone ground-floor bay windows, jettied Tudor upper storey, dual brick chimneys, and the painted gold-and-maroon Anchor & Brass signboard mounted on its front crossbeam.
models.unreal_role: Quayside Landmark Public House ( TownTavernV4 + Mounted SignAnchorTavern )

models.title: Ironcrag Blast Foundry
models.description: 15 m red-brick Victorian blast foundry with arched casting-floor windows, vented clerestory roof monitor, and integrated square brick furnace stack.
models.unreal_role: South-Wharf Heavy Industrial Smelting Works ( 15 m Brick Clerestory Hall )

models.title: Rail-Mounted Steam Dock Crane
models.description: 18.5 m rail-straddling steel portal dock crane with a riveted boiler cab, vertical exhaust chimney, lattice jib boom, sheave block, and heavy cargo hook.
models.unreal_role: Coaling Pier & Foundry Wharf Cargo Portal Crane ( 18.5 m Lattice Jib )

models.title: Harbour Coaling Tipple
models.description: 24 m dockside coaling station combining an inclined bucket-conveyor ramp, overhead coal storage hoppers, counterweighted gravity chutes, and timber-and-iron trestles.
models.unreal_role: Bunkering Wharf Coal Elevator & Chute Tower ( 24 m Industrial Tipple )

models.title: Stigsby Ridge Windmill
models.description: 22 m coastal stone-and-timber smock windmill crowned by an ogee cap and four articulated oak lattice sail sweeps overlooking the approaches.
models.unreal_role: Headland Daymark & Grain Mill ( Tower + 4 Rotating Lattice Sail Sweeps )

models.title: 1870s Oilskin Mariner
models.description: 1.78 m Victorian merchant mariner dressed in dark weatherproof oilskins, double-breasted peacoat, sea boots, and peaked cap for shipboard helm and quayside duty.
models.unreal_role: Quarterdeck Helmsman, Salvage Rigger & Quay Dockhand ( 1.78 m Crew Mesh )

models.title: Harbour Herring Gull
models.description: 1.30 m wingspan coastal herring gull assembled from SeaGullV4 with hinged port and starboard primary wings posed in a slight dihedral harbour glide.
models.unreal_role: Ambient Harbour & Wake Flock Bird ( 1.30 m Span, Hinged L/R Wings )
